## Ctx.getIntent() method

Extracts the intent portion from a string containing args.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getIntent(str: string | undefined, mtd: Parameters<typeof this.getSeperatorTag>[0], positionEnd?: number): string;
```

## Example


